title.narrative: GW of renewable energy capacity enabled

comment.narrative: For the full year 2024, Armenia reported installed capacities of 286.5 MW of utility-scale solar PV plants, 304.8 MW of solar PV systems subject to net metering, and 4 MW of wind power plants, bringing the total to 595.3 MW. Compared to the 2022 baseline, this reflects an overall increase of 189 MW, including 81 MW of new utility-scale capacity and 108 MW of additional solar PV systems under net metering.

title.narrative: GW of renewable energy capacity enabled

comment.narrative: As of December 2025, Armenia reported total installed renewable energy capacity of 1,121.35 MW, comprising utility-scale solar PV plants and distributed solar PV systems under net metering. Compared to the 2022 baseline of 361.8 MW, this represents an overall increase of approximately 760 MW, reflecting the rapid scale-up of both utility-scale and distributed solar generation over the period.
